passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Piercing Light
spells.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Ardent Blaze
spells.description: Lucian fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage, briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds. When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains Move Speed for 1 second. Allies triggering this effect will also grant Lucian Vigilance.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Relentless Pursuit
spells.description: Lucian dashes. Cooldown is reduced by second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger ( seconds for champions).
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: The Culling
spells.description: Lucian rapidly fires shots in a direction for seconds or until he Recasts. Each shot deals physical damage to the first enemy hit. While firing, Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit. Total Damage: physical damage
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamagePerBullet was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
